There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are noted.  
  
 The lateral compartment, there is horizontal tear at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. A 1 cm subchondral bone cyst is present. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are noted.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Few subchondral bone cysts (about cm) are identified. Osteophytes are noted. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact The posterior cruciate ligament is intact There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of right knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Tricompartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral cyst and osteophytes.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir. Medial menisküs hafif ekstrüde görünümdedir.Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde kompleks arka boynuzda radial  yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi. Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı ve parsiyel rüptür ile uyumlu olabilecek sinyal değişklikleri mevcuttur.Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Tibia proksimalinde medial epikondil düzeyinde hafif kemik iliği ödemi ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri izlenmiştir.Patellar kemik yapışma düzeyinde belirgin sinyal artışı izlenmektedir. Suprapateller bursada ve diz eklemi seviyesinde sıvı artışı izlenmektedir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.

Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs au niveau patellofémoral avec amincissement modéré du cartilage à la facette latérale de la rotule. Il y a un léger amincissement au niveau de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a aussi léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et externe. Il n’y a aucune région de perte de cartilage complet.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ménisque interne, le ménisque externe, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments du genou sans région de perte de cartilage complet tel que détaillé ci-haut.

2. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

3. Aucune déchirure méniscale.

МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Наличе на енхондром в тибията. МР данни за костномозъчен едем в медиалните конидили на фемура и тибията и ръбови остеофити на тези кондили. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и на тибията е изтънен до липсващ от страната на медиалното тибиално плато – промени, съотвеетстващи на медиален остеоартрит. Предна кръстна връзка е проследима по цялото си протежение, лекостепенно задебелена и с повишен сигнален интензитет, както при частична мукоидна дегенерация в средна и горна трета на връзката. Задната кръстна връзка се проследява до залавните си места с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Състояние след менискектомия на медиален менискус – задният му рог е частично отстранен, с останалата част от менискуса е експулсирана встрани. Нормално изобразяване на предния му рог. Латерален менискус – с нормален МР образ. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на меките тъкани на лявото коляно. Заключение: МР данни за медиален остеоартрит на дясната колянна става. Суспектни данни за частична мукоидна дегенерация на предната кръстна връзка, като последната е със запазена цялост. Енхондром. Увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус – частично отстранен и експулсиран встрани. Костномозъчен едем.

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis along weight-baring, non weight-baring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes 
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis along weight-baring lateral femoral condyle. Focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema at lateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2 cm). Osteophytes are present.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 There is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
 There is chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament. Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are suspected. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Large amount of effusion with synovitis is present in right knee including popliteus recess. There are multiple osteocartilaginous loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess. The surrounding musculature is normal.   -- Moderate tri-compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
 -- Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 -- Chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament.  
 -- Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes. 
 -- Large amount of effusion with synovitis and multiple loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess: probable for secondary synovial osteochondromatosis.

Lateralisiert stehende Patella. Ansonsten regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse. Tiefgreifender, bis an den knochenreichender Knorpeldefekt an der lateralen Patellafacette großflächig mit bis zu 1,7 cm und chondralen Fibrillationen (4/8). Angrenzend teils geringes Knochenmarködem (5/8). Femorotibial regelrechte Stellung. V. a. horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia am Übergang zum Hinterhorn (5/26, 8/9 oder 3/125). Keine dislozierten Anteile. Kein Korbhenkelriss. Keine relevante Chondropathie femorotibial. Geringes subkortikales Ödem im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kreuzbänder intakt. Außenmeniskus intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Geringe Flüssigkeit um das MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Signalanhebungen am Ansatz der Quadrizepssehne und am Ursprung der Patellasehne (8/28), in erster Linie bei Reizzustand. Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die umgebende Subcutis. Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit im medialen und lateralen Recessus gelegenen kleinen länglichen Strukturen (3/25). Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.

 Patellofemoral compartment

 Others

  Neurovascular bundles are intact.  Chronic complete tear of the right ACL with ligamentous resorption. 
  About intact8cm anterior tibial translation 
  Horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the right medial meniscus. 
  Minimal right knee joint effusion.

FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

There are severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss and subchondral reactive changes. There is lateral subluxation and lateral tilt of the patella. There is moderate cartilage thinning involving the lateral compartment with a large cartilage defect of the central aspect of the lateral tibial plateau.

There is diffuse intrasubstance degeneration, maceration and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degeneration of the body without a well-defined linear tear.

There is intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL. There is no evidence of acute ligament injury.

Otherwise the PCL, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Severe degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Diffuse degenerative tearing with maceration and extrusion of the medial meniscus.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without evidence of acute ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis with a nonruptured popliteal cyst.

Conclusion :

La résonance magnétique du genou gauche est dans les limites de la normale, sans dérangement interne. 

Il n'y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire.

Trouvailles: 
Il y a une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse plus proéminent impliquant le fémur distalement. Il n'y a pas de composante tissulaire extra-osseuse. Il y a changements similaires mais moins marqués impliquant le tibia et le péroné proximalement. 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. Il y a un kyste ganglionnaire multi-loculé de 2cm AP x 1.8cm transverse x 1cm cranio-caudal au niveau de la région intercondylienne antérieure. Aucune évidence de déchirure méniscale associée. Le kyste semble être en provenance des fibres distales du ligament croisé antérieur. 
Il y a proéminence et fragmentation de la tubérosité tibiale sans oedème osseux compatible avec une ancienne maladie de Osgood-Schlatter. 
Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

4. Découverte fortuite d'une apparence hétérogène de la moelle osseuse. Ceci est non-spécifique et pourrait représenter une reconversion en moelle rouge. Un processus infiltratif est moins probable mais demeure dans le diagnostic différentiel. Une investigation hématologique est recommandée.
